title: Irradiated Stranger at the Hatch
bodyText: Heavy knocks echo against the steel airlock. Through the viewglass, an unarmored wanderer clutches a coughing chest, begging for shelter from the rising fallout.

choices.text: Open the hatch and let them inside.

delayedConsequence.title: Stranger's Gratitude
delayedConsequence.description: The recovered stranger shares a hidden stash of supplies before leaving.

choices.text: Keep the hatch sealed and tell them to move on.

title: The Last Iodine Dose
bodyText: Only one iodine tablet remains in the cabinet. The child is showing early symptoms, but the scavenger must cross the hot zone at dawn for vital fuel.

choices.text: Administer the iodine to the child.
Save the dose for the dawn scavenger mission.

title: Mid-Night Filter Breach
bodyText: A sudden squall tears at the intake vent. Black dust rattles through the ductwork as the air filtration alarm buzzes in the dark.

choices.text: Send someone into the intake shaft to manual-seal the leak.
Replace the damaged filter element immediately.

title: Ticking Water Supply
bodyText: The dosimeter chatters rhythmically when brought near the main water barrel. Fine grey sediment has settled at the bottom.

choices.text: Purify the reservoir using the water still.
Ignore the clicking and issue rations as usual.

title: The Trader's Offer
bodyText: A traveling scavenger stands outside holding an military dosimeter. They demand three units of clean water in exchange.

choices.text: Hand over the clean water for the dosimeter.
Keep your water reserves.

title: Degraded Hatch Gasket
bodyText: Sub-zero winds crack the rubber gasket along the outer bunker door. Frost lines the interior hinges.

choices.text: Use sealant and rags to reinforce the door frame.
Burn extra fuel to compensate for the draft.

title: Collapse at the Trench
bodyText: A local scavenger collapses ten yards from the airlock, clutching a sealed crate of canned food.

choices.text: Braving the fallout to drag them and their crate inside.
Quickly snatch the crate and lock the door.

title: Missing Anti-Rad Dose
bodyText: An audit of the emergency medical kit reveals one missing anti-rad ampoule. Suspicion hangs heavy in the common room.

choices.text: Search everyone's quarters to find the culprit.
Keep silent and avoid fracturing the group.

title: Static on the Shortwave
bodyText: The shortwave radio crackles with a faint voice repeating coordinates five miles north, claiming to hold clean seed stock.

choices.text: Log the coordinates for future scavenge runs.
Warn them of nearby hot zones over the radio.

title: Leaking Fuel Drum
bodyText: A hairline crack in the primary fuel drum drips diesel onto the concrete floor. Strong fumes fill the corridor.

choices.text: Siphon what remains into smaller containers.
Attempt to weld and patch the leak under fumes.

title: Swollen Rations
bodyText: Two cans of meat in the pantry have expanded. Hunger is mounting, but botulism or radiation contamination is likely.

choices.text: Throw the swollen cans out the trash chute.
Boil and eat the meat to stave off starvation.

title: Asleep at the Watch
bodyText: During the 4 AM check, the night sentry is found fast asleep against the airlock door, rifle lying in the dirt.

choices.text: Issue a stern reprimand and double their shift.
Take over watch duty silently and let them rest.

title: Sub-Zero Power Failure
bodyText: The generator throws a spark and dies. Darkness falls as interior temperatures plunge toward freezing.

choices.text: Work in the freezing dark to clear the fuel line.
Gather everyone in the inner room with thermal blankets.

title: Scratching at the Outflow
bodyText: A emaciated stray dog whimpers outside the drainage outflow. Its fur is patchy from fallout exposure.

choices.text: Share a scrap of food and let it sleep in the airlock.
Drive the animal away to conserve resources.

title: Refugee's Last Exchange
bodyText: A refugee family at the outer gate offers two fuel canisters in exchange for your last iodine pills.

choices.text: Trade the iodine pills for the fuel canisters.
Keep your iodine reserves.
